name: Zoetry Agua Punta Cana
positioning: All-suite, all-inclusive beach resort in Uvero Alto with thatched, Taino-inspired architecture, a spa and two infinity pools
best_for: Travelers who want an all-inclusive beach stay built around spa time, yoga and the pools
Guests curious about Dominican culture through cooking, cigar rolling and wine tasting

facts.text: An all-suite resort on the beach of Uvero Alto, on the easternmost coast of the Dominican Republic.
The resort sits north of the sprawling all-inclusives of Punta Cana.
Hard woods, palapa (cane-thatched) roofs, cathedral ceilings and natural stone touches showcase the resort's eco-friendly architecture and nod to the Dominican Republic's history.
The open-air lobby has a soaring peaked thatch roof.
Rooms are divided between two-story thatched buildings and freestanding villas, no more than a one-minute walk from the beach.
Rooms have dark hardwood floors and furniture, white-on-white beds and immense bathrooms with black slate showers and deep soaking tubs.
The resort is all-inclusive under Zoetry's Endless Privileges, where everything is included.
There are four a la carte restaurants serving Caribbean and international flavors.
The Zoetry Spa offers indigenous treatments.
Yoga classes include Flow, Gentle and Hatha, along with pranayama meditation.
Water activities include kayaking, catamaran and snorkeling, with kite surfing lessons, fishing and scuba diving at additional cost.

highlights.text: The suites draw inspiration from nature and the indigenous Taino culture, with palapa roofs, cathedral ceilings, teak furniture and rich wood accents.
The resort has two large infinity pools and serpentine water trails.
The Zoetry Spa has Finnish and steam saunas, an indoor pool with Inox bubble beds, sensation showers and Natura Bisse products.
Local-culture experiences include wine tasting with the resort's sommelier, horseback riding on the beach, cooking classes and cigar rolling classes.
The resort has a 200-yard stretch of beach along the Caribbean Sea.

considerations.text: The last two miles of the approach road are very rough; a helicopter transfer from Punta Cana airport takes about ten minutes.
Activity programming changes through the year and depends on the weather; some activities, such as scuba diving and fishing, cost extra.
WhataHotel notes a higher price point than neighboring resorts.
